message: Last winter, we hunkered down for a blizzard that had everyone buzzing about. Instead of fretting, I pulled out our favorite board games and made a big pot of chili. We played, laughed, and watched the snow pile up outside, turning the storm into our own cozy event. Sometimes, a little preparation can turn a wild weather day into a cherished memory. What’s your favorite way to make the best of a stormy situation?
